explanation: API lemma for the bespoke `comparableGraph` used for erdosproblems.com/777, where G_F is the graph on a family F of subsets of {1,…,n} with A ~ B when A and B are comparable (A ⊆ B or B ⊆ A). The definition makes two members adjacent iff one is a proper subset of the other, which is the comparability relation with loops removed, as a simple graph requires. The lemma just unfolds this (`Iff.rfl`, fully proved). Correct.
